Three means a crowd: each row belongs together by restrained costume/material motif and complementary personality, but each actor must function independently outside group. No handoffs, pointing at neighbour, overlaps or shared objects.

Hands are goo continuous with body. No humanoid torso/legs/feet/busts, no whole coats/robes hiding goo. Dark ink face/body dominant, accessories small and readable. Every OPEN eye has WHITE/ivory sclera surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil. Planned cyclops has same colour rule. No all-red/glowing eyeballs. Offbeat absurd/surreal satirical peak acting, not generic cute Pixar babies, no repeated V-brow tooth grin. Differentiate body contour, eye/lid shapes, mouth, posture and temperament BEFORE props. Some mouths closed, some open, unequal gazes; NO protruding tongue in ANY cell.

Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512. Similar overall body size, no giant boss. Few bold simple functional handmade props, rich softly rounded wood/metal/cloth, not machinery clutter. Entire figure isolated, no floor/cast shadows/scenelet/scenery/extra heads.

Terrifyingly cordial CLOSED crooked smile, high rounded brows and one half-lid. Holds ONE squat old cream PORCELAIN TEAPOT with thick copper lid, no cup/pouring.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT male overruled adult son. TALL very narrow drooping ink pear, one long sagging crown hook, TWO small offset lower teeth. Unequal white/red/black eyes look UP, tired worried sagging underbite. Hugs ONE small cream PLATE holding ONE lonely crumbled toast corner, all attached to own hands.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male grandfather of the gathering. COMPACT almost-square ROUND-lobed upright ink splat with three low crown nubs, heavy wrinkled lids, single ivory lower tusk. Offended teeth-clenched sideways stare. Both goo hands hold ONE enormous old copper ALARM CLOCK with fat bells and BLANK face with TWO physical hands only, no digits.

BOTTOM ROW TRIO: Die letzte trockene Stelle. Context: Original three-person plumbing crew. SHARED restrained belonging cue: tiny faded TEAL work caps with little COPPER circles, short ochre work collars; dark ink bodies exposed.
LEFT: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ plumbing forewoman. TALL broad upright rounded trapezoid ink blob, TWO strong sideways crown curls, lashes, THREE uneven upper teeth. One brow high and other eye narrowed, CLOSED compressed severe lower lip. Holds ONE thick old red PIPE WRENCH, short and beautifully rounded, no pipe maze.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT male hopeful apprentice. SMALL lanky tilted ink bean, one springy crown nub, ONE enormous square lower tooth. Huge wide asymmetric eyes DOWN, crooked nervous lip. Carefully holds ONE massive black RUBBER WASHER with clear round hole as though it were the missing answer, no extra tools.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male pompous work inspector. VERY WIDE low upright ink splat, three thick blunt crown lobes, two tiny upper fangs, thick heavy lower lip. Disapproving nearly closed WHITE/red/black eyes, CLOSED lip folded into a long pout. Hugs ONE short silver PIPE ELBOW fitted with ONE chunky brass pressure gauge, blank face/two thick hands only; compact self-contained prop.
EMPTY BACKGROUND AND HOLES ACTUAL ALPHA0, interiors opaque with soft antialiased outer edge only. No gradient/matte/checkerboard/floor/shadowdiscs, no lettering/numbers/logos/labels/borders or floating punctuation. Six complete distinct characters, two coherent TRIOS, exactly TWO female-read figures in sheet. Body/face individuality first; group relationship second; simple iconic props third.
SPACING PRIORITY OVERRIDE: sparse contact sheet with SMALL FIGURES, each only about65percent of its cell height, ample empty gaps. COMPLETE actor+props bounding box MAX340x340, at least86px transparent padding INSIDE each512cell. Don't fill the sheet, don't let any prop reach another row or column.
